scope: Post-test diagnostic analysis only. No refitting, retuning, relabelling or exclusions.
event_label_caveat: Mismatches are against intended/count-aligned references; they do not independently establish transmitted Morse or operator versus decoder fault.
gap_alignment: Only gaps between consecutive matched reference pulses are compared. Other detected gaps remain unscored.
error_categories: Detection/pulse/gap mismatch flags may co-occur. Disjoint combinations are saved separately.
edit_alignment: Minimum Levenshtein alignment; ties prefer diagonal then deletion then insertion. Edit-operation counts are not causal attribution.
